Resolves #19155

`getExistingSitemapLastmodMap` now reads one `<url>` block at a time and maps an entry only when that block has both a `loc` and a `lastmod`. The old single pattern let `[\s\S]*?` run past `</url>`. An undated entry searched to the end of the file, from every such entry, and took the next entry's date whenever one followed. A sitemap written without git history is entirely undated, so a pages build re-run at an unchanged engine version spun inside `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs`. The function is now exported so its unit arms can reach it without git.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms on the exported function, red-first against the old pattern, plus an outside-CI measurement on a real 19,293-URL sitemap) → L2 required (AC-1–AC-3 are the function's own behaviour). Residual: none.

Change class: `fix`. It restores the function's documented behaviour, and the export is a test seam. `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs` › *an entry without lastmod neither takes the next entry's date nor swallows that entry*. Red on the old pattern: `{"https://neomjs.com/a": "2026-09-01"}` instead of `…/b`. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: same spec › *a sitemap without any lastmod maps nothing* (2,000 entries). Speed, outside CI: on pages' real lastmod-less sitemap (1,534,339 bytes, 19,293 `<url>`, 0 `<lastmod>`), the old pattern was killed by SIGTERM at 60 s, and the fixed read returns 0 entries in 3 ms. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: same spec › *dated entries map loc to lastmod, whichever tag comes first*. |

## Deltas from ticket
- A block with `<lastmod>` before `<loc>` now maps too. The old pattern required `<loc>` first, and the generator always writes it first. AC-3 on #19155 is corrected to say so.
- AC-2's speed claim is an outside-CI measurement plus the structure of the fix (each block is read once), not a CI timing ceiling.

## Test Evidence
- Red-first: with only the export added and the old pattern in place, 2 of the 4 new arms fail: AC-1's cross-entry pairing, and the tag-order arm, where `…/b` is missing. With the fix, all 11 arms in the spec pass. `unit/buildScripts/` has 803 passing.
- Outside CI, as the AC-2 row says: 60 s SIGTERM against 3 ms, on the sitemap the pages dry run (neomjs/pages#10) left behind.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] pages picks this up with the engine release it installs. Until then, pages#10's re-runs delete the stale `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` first, as its test notes say.

Related: #19047 · neomjs/pages#10 · #12261 (origin)
